title: Titanium Hypersonic Control Surface
alloyReason: Ti-65 near-alpha titanium alloy is engineered for Titanium Hypersonic Control Surface in high-temperature aero engine applications capable of sustained operation at 600°C — 100°C above the service limit of Ti-6Al-4V. Silicide precipitation along alpha plate boundaries provides creep resistance below 0.1% strain at 300 MPa / 600°C / 100 hours. This elevated temperature capability is essential for Hypersonic missile all-moving fin (Ti-65) in the hot section of gas turbine engines. This rationale is driven by hypersonic missile all-moving fin (ti-65) and service environment demands.
process: 5-axis CNC roughing for missile hardware geometry
Wire EDM contour profiling with SPC sampling
CMM per AS9102 with SPC sampling
surfaceTreatment: Shot peening Almen 0.008-0.012A inducing compressive residual stress for extended HCF life in aerospace service — tailored for hypersonic missile allmoving application
commonFailures: SCC in chloride-rich marine atmosphere - controlled by bake-out 300C + corrosion-inhibiting primer — critical for hypersonic missile allmoving performance

faq.q: What fatigue life can Titanium Hypersonic Control Surface achieve under flight load spectra?
faq.a: Titanium Hypersonic Control Surface designed to safe-life criteria per MIL-STD-1530 demonstrates minimum 10⁵ flight cycles for hypersonic missile allmoving at 75% of yield strength. The fatigue crack growth rate in Ti-65 follows da/dN = 2.2×10⁻⁸ (ΔK)³·² m/cycle in air, with a threshold ΔKth of approximately 5.5 MPa√m. Crack growth predictions use AFGROW or NASGRO with validated material data.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Hypersonic Control Surface orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Hypersonic Control Surface is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Hypersonic Control Surface?
faq.a: Each Titanium Hypersonic Control Surface shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for hypersonic missile allmoving.
